text: 2026年11月6日，美国Netlist, Inc. of Irvine, California根据《美国1930年关税法》第337节规定向美国国际贸易委员会提出申请，主张对美出口、在美进口及销售的特定动态随机存取存储器(DRAM)设备、NAND闪存设备及其下游产品和组件违反了美国337条款。（中国贸易救济信息网）
text_en: On November 6, 2026, Netlist, Inc. of Irvine, California, filed an application with the US International Trade Commission under Section 337 of the US Tariff Act of 1930, alleging that certain dynamic random access memory (DRAM) devices, NAND flash memory devices and downstream products and components thereof exported to, imported into and sold in the United States violate US Section 337. (China Trade Remedy Information Network)
